title: Debt, accrued interest and covenants — Draper Marine
instructions: Audit **Draper Marine's** note payable at December 31.

exhibits.title: Note payable
exhibits.content: Principal **$2,000,000**; interest **6%**, paid semiannually on **March 1** and **September 1**. Draper accrued **$30,000** of interest at December 31.

exhibits.title: Covenant
exhibits.content: Total liabilities to equity may not exceed **1.50**. Before any adjustment: total liabilities **$4,500,000**; equity **$3,000,000**. No waiver has been obtained.

rows.label: Is the covenant violated after the adjustment?
Without a waiver making the debt not callable, must the note be classified as current?
rows.explanation: Debt callable because of a violation is current.

rows.label: Should the auditor confirm the terms and balance with the lender?
rows.explanation: Confirmation gives external evidence of terms.

rows.label: Is an immaterial interest adjustment always irrelevant?
rows.explanation: Even a small amount matters when it triggers a covenant violation.
